question: I'm retired and on a fixed income and I just can't afford this tax bill. Is there any help?
notes: CITIZEN VOICE. Written deliberately in the register a resident uses at the counter, not statutory language. Added 2026-08-03 after discovering the existing suites were phrased semi-statutorily and therefore could not detect the citizen-phrasing retrieval defect at all — the one clerk case that caught it did so by accident. Answer must route to the poverty exemption and the board of review, not to a payment plan the assessor cannot offer.
